prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and component identity alignment. Asset: ONE standalone twin-drill tracked engineering machine, the fourth machine of Social Brave King. Image 1 is the old vehicle concept, images 2-4 are the current authoritative combined robot appearance. Make a clean updated master illustration on ivory background, wide 3:2 landscape, front-left three-quarter view, complete vehicle in frame. Precise KINETIC_CEL black contour and restrained cel-shaded orange/ivory/graphite armor, no photoreal grime, no warehouse, no lettering, no robot torso, fists or human thighs.

Keep a low, broad, powerful futuristic rescue/excavation vehicle with exactly TWO short substantial silver conical segmented drills pointing forward, each in an orange circular pivot collar. These are the same two drills seen on the robot's knee fronts in image 2. The chassis is made of TWO mirrored long LEFT/RIGHT modules coupled along one clear longitudinal central seam; they form one joined vehicle in travel mode. Each half contains its own complete tracked running gear, white segmented armor and orange structural spine. The two halves will later become the left and right lower-leg/foot external assemblies, so visibly reuse the black track tread pattern, exposed dark wheel hubs, white polygonal shin/side armor plates, orange guards, black recessed grilles, thick ivory/orange boot-like rear chassis end from images 2-4. Real continuous belt loops return around wheels, not loose ribbons or tracks hanging under a wheel. Make the side-facing large wheels/return arcs understandable and have both halves sit on the same ground plane.

The forward drill collars have simple hinges allowing them to stay forward-facing at the knee when the long module rotates into an upright shin position; show credible hinge rings, not a detailed transformation. Closed rear chassis end armor can later unfold into the robot's thick foot/heel. A small blue-black armored observation strip is integrated into each half's sloped upper shell; avoid a tall separate truck cab that would need to disappear in combined mode. Keep the vehicle compact and consistent with the combined parts: clearly defined orange frame, ivory plates, dark graphite running gear, small metallic drills, no random spikes or extra weapons. Preserve two front drills, two coupled leg modules, readable front/rear and credible track paths. No disassembly in this master; draw the closed complete vehicle.
